recognize_zh: 視野中央有一個香蕉形／新月形的蟲體，內含棒狀深色瘧色素，宿主紅血球被撐長只剩一圈淡邊，這是惡性瘧原蟲配子體（crescent gametocyte）的典型形態。
features: Crescent/banana-shaped intraerythrocytic parasite, a P. falciparum gametocyte
Dark rod-like hemozoin pigment granules within the parasite
Host red cell membrane visible as a faint rim around the crescent
Surrounding red cells normocytic without ring forms or stippling in this field
describe_en: Smear shows a single crescent-shaped (banana-shaped) intraerythrocytic parasite containing dark rod-like hemozoin pigment, with the host red cell outline visible as a faint rim. Surrounding red cells are normocytic and no ring forms are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with a Plasmodium falciparum gametocyte, diagnostic of falciparum malaria; parasitemia should be quantified on peripheral blood films.

ddx.vs: Vivax and ovale gametocytes are round and fill an enlarged red cell with Schuffner dots rather than being crescent-shaped.
P. malariae band trophozoites lie across a normal-sized red cell as a straight band, not a curved crescent with rounded ends.
Babesia produces small rings and tetrads without hemozoin pigment or gametocytes.
